name: Creative Mode
displayDescription: Switch to Creative in the story or any Survival server: fly (double-tap jump), take any block in the game, break blocks instantly and never get hurt or hungry. In Survival, Jerry leaves you alone. Press G to switch, C to pick blocks.

name: VIP
displayDescription: A gold [VIP] tag in chat, triple bones from the daily reward, and two VIP-only cosmetics: Jerry's Gold Collar and the Gold Cape.

name: Ray's Kit
displayDescription: Uncle Ray's old kit: every time you spawn in Survival you get an iron pickaxe, axe and sword, 8 bread and 16 torches.

name: Name Jerry
displayDescription: Give Jerry a name of your own. In your story runs, everyone's dialogue uses it. Filtered for everyone's safety.

name: 2x Bones
displayDescription: Double the bones you earn from kills, mining, story chapters, endings and surviving nights. Forever.

name: God Pickaxe
displayDescription: A glowing pickaxe that mines a 3x3 with every swing, never wears out, and is yours in the story and in Survival: a fresh one every time you spawn. Only pass owners can use it.
